items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: we thought that they were just hollering at us because Cab had these banners on the bus, 'Cab Calloway and Orchestra'

ctx.x: So we all got out of the bus and trotted up there, and Chu was there lying, Lamar was crying, Brown he was there looking sad. Chu was hurting where his belt had broke and boy, then we lifted him back in the bus and called an ambulance and a couple days after that he died, you know, it was a terrible night. So anyway, that night that Chu passed we noticed Cab came on the bandstand. He was very sad that night, we probably figured something had happened, we hadn't received any word from the hospital as yet. Then…
